plan_a: Painter artifact-combo/prison: the kill is Painter's Servant naming a color plus Grindstone, milling the opponent's whole library in one activation (Manifold Key / Voltaic Key untaps Grindstone to fire it early). Around that combo sits a fast-mana artifact prison — Ancient Tomb, Grim Monolith, Lotus Petal, Mox Opal power out Karn, the Great Creator and Tezzeret to lock the board and tutor pieces from the sideboard toolbox, with The One Ring and Urza's Saga for card advantage and bodies. Unlike the other decks in this pool the decision profile is more resource/prison sequencing than instant-speed stack war, but the Painter+Grindstone line and Karn-activated sideboard swaps still exercise combo-assembly and toolbox-search choices. Note: several card names in this list are from very recent/unverified sets and should be validated against the Forge card database before use.
plan_b: Red burn: the plan is simple and fast — point every burn spell (Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Spike, Rift Bolt, Fireblast) at the opponent's FACE and deploy one-drops (Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear, Eidolon of the Great Revel) for extra reach. Price of Progress punishes nonbasics. Only kill their creatures if you'd otherwise die. Count lethal every turn; you usually win by turn 4 — race, don't durdle.
